eps.o: There's something new about Trolley, and Daniel is so excited to find out what it is! As he waits, he learns new things about his friends. In the end, Daniel discovers that Trolley can turn into a boat. Daniel and his friends enjoy a ride!
Teacher Harriet helps Daniel make a chart to ask his friends how they like to say hello.
When Miss Elaina and Katerina play together, they ask each other how they like to play. Sometimes they like different things!

eps.t: Daniel Doesn't Want to Miss Out
eps.o: Daniel has to go potty, but is worried there won't be space for his sea turtle on the class mural when he's done in the bathroom.
Prince Wednesday needs to get dressed before he can go outside to see the butterflies and play with Chrissie.
When Daniel and O are playing post office, their wagon breaks. They look around and find something else to use.

eps.t: Jodi Makes a Boat with Max
eps.o: Jodi and Nana see Teacher Harriet and Max playing with a homemade boat. Jodi uses things she finds in nature to make one, too.

eps.t: Daniel and Mom Make a Treat
eps.o: Daniel is upset when he can’t make banana swirl, but Mom shows him another snack they can make together.

eps.t: Jodi Sleeps at Her Dad's House
eps.o: When a backyard campout is rained out, Jodi, Teddy and Leo find that they can still have a special night being together.
Daniel is sad when he can't make footprints in the snow like Prince Wednesday, so he makes them his own way.

eps.t: Katerina and O Go Ice Skating
eps.o: Katerina is upset when she can't read like O. She learns she can read the story in her own way by describing the pictures.
Daniel runs into Grandpere’s house with dirty shoes and makes a mess. Daniel says sorry and helps Grandpere clean.
O and Miss Elaina are playing with her robot when O accidentally breaks it. O says sorry and helps Miss Elaina fix it.
Daniel wants to ride in the stroller to the Music Shop, but Dad shows him that Margaret needs it.
O wants to sit in the front of Trolley, but Jodi gets carsick in the back. O realizes he doesn't need the front seat like she does.

eps.t: Daniel and Max Visit the Farm
eps.o: Daniel helps care for animals at the farm.
Prince Wednesday and Jodi learn how to care for a guinea pig.
Daniel is frustrated when Juan Carlos doesn’t pretend the same way he does.
Chrissie gets upset when O plays horse differently than her. X shows them that there are so many ways to pretend.
Daniel uses a new bathroom.

Daniel and Grandpere Go Slow

eps.t: Daniel Helps at the Crayon Factory
eps.o: Daniel Helps at the Crayon Factory
Miss Elaina Swims
Teddy is nervous for a boat ride on Trolley, but Daniel helps him to be brave! They enjoy the ride together.

eps.t: Miss Elaina is Brave at the Dentist
eps.o: When Miss Elaina is nervous at the dentist, her daddy and Dr. Plat help her to feel brave.
When Daniel and his friends learn to play T-ball, they find out that Henrietta is a dance teacher and a T-ball coach.
Max learns that Mr. McFeely is the story time reader and a mail carrier. You can be more than one thing!
